# Risk and control assessment (`risk-control` v1)

A risk, its inherent rating, the controls against it and the residual rating (RCSA).

**Group:** Operational and non-financial risk · **Mnemonic:** `RCSA` · **Identifiers:** `RCSA-…` in `assessmentId`

Open one with `RCSA <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: risk-control
version: 1
description: "A risk, its inherent rating, the controls against it and the residual rating (RCSA)."
match: { kind: risk-control, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Operational and non-financial risk · Risk and control assessment, id: $.assessmentId }
strip:
  - { label: Risk, bind: $.risk }
  - { label: Desk, bind: $.deskName }
  - { label: Inherent, bind: $.inherent }
  - { label: Control effectiveness, bind: $.effectiveness, tone: status }
  - { label: Residual, bind: $.residual, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Next review, bind: $.nextReview, fmt: date }
panels:
  - id: controls
    kind: table
    title: Controls
    key: F2
    rows: $.controls
    columns:
      - { label: Control, bind: "@.control" }
      - { label: Type, bind: "@.type" }
      - { label: Frequency, bind: "@.frequency" }
      - { label: Last test, bind: "@.lastTest", fmt: date }
      - { label: Result, bind: "@.result", tone: status }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.desk, 'desk')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
